Package com.rocket.radar.events

Class FilterModel

java.lang.Object
androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
com.rocket.radar.events.FilterModel
public class FilterModel extends androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
ViewModel for managing event filters in the application. Maintains a collection of EventFilter instances and applies them to event streams.

    • getFilters

      public Stream<FilterModel.EventFilter> getFilters()
      Gets a stream of all non-null active filters.
      Returns:
      a stream of active EventFilter instances

    • addFilter

      public int addFilter(FilterModel.EventFilter eventFilter)
      Adds a filter to the model. If there are null positions (from removed filters), the filter will fill the first available position; otherwise, it is added to the end.
      Parameters:
      eventFilter - the filter to add
      Returns:
      the ID (index) of the added filter

    • removeFilterByName

      public void removeFilterByName(@NonNull String filterName)
      Removes all filters with the specified name by setting their positions to null.
      Parameters:
      filterName - the name of the filter(s) to remove

    • removeFilterById

      public void removeFilterById(int filterId)
      Removes a filter at the specified ID by setting its position to null.
      Parameters:
      filterId - the ID (index) of the filter to remove

    • removeFiltersByCategory

      public void removeFiltersByCategory(String category)
      Removes all filters belonging to the specified category by setting their positions to null.
      Parameters:
      category - the category of filters to remove

    • clearFilters

      public void clearFilters()
      Removes all filters from the model by clearing the filter list.

    • filter

      public Stream<Event> filter(Stream<Event> events)
      Applies all active filters to a stream of events. Each non-null filter is applied sequentially to the event stream.
      Parameters:
      events - the stream of events to filter
      Returns:
      the filtered stream of events
